html:
The Mayi-Kutuna, also spelt Mayaguduna, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the Gulf country of northwest Queensland, on the map along the Leichhardt River south of the Gulf of Carpentaria.

Their language, one of the Mayi group, is now extinct. Neighbours included the Wakabunga, Mayi-Yapi, Nguburinji, Kukatj and Mingin. Burketown was founded near the Gulf in the 1860s, and cattle stations spread up the rivers.
sum: The Mayi-Kutuna, also spelt Mayaguduna, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the Gulf country of northwest Queensland, on the map along the Leichhardt River south of the Gulf of Carpentaria.
